summary: Executed backend+frontend regression focused on FIR photo upload/retry and package/payment guards on preview URL. Backend core workflows passed (24/26 tests), with two auth-security playbook failures. FIR UI flows passed for no-auto-camera-on-load, retry-after-503, continue-without-photo, invalid/oversize file validation, and mobile capture attribute. PRO package create/payment UI works when awaited correctly; payment sync updates remaining and ledger after refresh delay.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout: 6th invalid login still returns 401 instead of expected 429/rate-limit.

minor.issue: access-control-allow-origin reflects cluster preview origin, not frontend/.env emergentagent origin; explicit-origin assertion failed in playbook test.

ui_bugs.issue: Immediate capture after camera start intermittently shows 'Camera is starting. Please try capturing again.'; requires retry.

integration_issues.issue: Could not reliably force NotAllowedError in this automation runtime; environment provides synthetic media stream, so denied-path remains partially unverified.

action_items: Implement and verify login brute-force protection (lockout/rate-limit after repeated failures).
Align CORS explicit origin policy with intended public frontend origin(s) for credentialed requests.
Re-test camera permission-denied path on a device/browser where getUserMedia denial can be reliably simulated or manually denied.
Add or restore /app/auth_testing.md playbook doc reference (file missing in this workspace run).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py currently falls back to allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True when CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset; tighten for clinical deployment.
Auth router has no failed-attempt tracking/lockout logic; this was already listed in PRD backlog and remains open.
Package/payment backend atomic guards are strong: concurrent overpay and concurrent duplicate-active creation were blocked as expected in new pytest coverage.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (critical FIR/package flows mostly passed; camera-denial simulation partially blocked by runtime)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Key synthetic IDs observed: SPARSA-000088 (patient created in FIR retry tests), package PKG-000028 (id 82e768aa-b503-4968-ba27-0953b0dcca9e) used for payment sync checks. FIR retry interception verified single registration per submission attempt in UI script context; backend test suites already cover FIR/photo RBAC and package/payment atomic guards. Remaining broad scope (full billing alternate-status bypass, reversal UI concurrency, full exports/analytics deltas, complete D→PRO→Pharmacy synthetic record chain) still needs dedicated passes.
rca of the issue: Auth failures RCA: (1) /api/auth/login implements credential check only and returns 401 on bad password without attempt counters; hence no 429 lockout. (2) CORS RCA: server.py uses permissive regex fallback when CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset, so allow-origin value tracks current host (cluster preview) and can diverge from frontend/.env base origin assertions. Camera-denial verification gap RCA: automation environment supplies synthetic/fake media stream, preventing consistent NotAllowedError reproduction.
